approaches.title: Frequency counting with mirrored construction
approaches.summary: Counts each letter, places half of each count in lexicographic order, and mirrors it to form the smallest palindrome. Revision 2 refactors the same frequency-based strategy using a left-half buffer and iterator-based construction.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Counts character frequencies and fills the output symmetrically from smallest to largest letters, placing an odd character in the center.

revisions.commitComment: more idomatic & no search for odd char
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3517: more idomatic & no search for odd char
revisions.commitBody:
- odd char can be directly indexed instead of searched
- use iterators and cloning to make code more idomatic
- fast unsafe parse into String
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Keeps frequency counting but builds a sorted left half, derives the center from the input, and appends the reversed half using more idiomatic Rust.

approaches.title: Sort-and-mirror construction
approaches.summary: Reuses the input allocation, sorts its first half, and mirrors that half across the output. This replaces frequency counting with direct sorting and in-place-style byte construction.

revisions.commitComment: much slower due to sort, but so clean and with less allocs!
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3517: much slower due to sort, but so clean and with less allocs!
revisions.commitBody:
also has no extra allocations other than during the sort.
- into_bytes reuses the original string allocation
- so does the final vec to string pointer cast
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces frequency counting with sorting the first half of the input bytes, then copies that half in reverse order to the second half.
